outcome: When several replacement or prevention effects apply to one event, the affected object's controller or the affected player picks which applies first, and the outcome follows that choice.
note: a choice with an observable consequence

outcome: A self-replacement effect is applied before any other replacement effect on the same event.
An effect changing under whose control an object enters is applied before other replacement effects.
An effect making an object enter as a copy is applied before other replacement effects, so the copy's abilities decide the rest.
An effect making a card enter back face up is applied before other replacement effects.
With no prioritised effect left, any applicable effect may be applied first, and the outcome follows the one chosen.
After one effect is applied, only effects still applicable to the modified event are applied, so an effect made inapplicable does nothing.
An effect on an event contained in another event is applied after the containing event's effect, such as token doubling before enters-as-copy.
A replacement or prevention effect becomes applicable to an event another effect has modified, such as prevention applying to redirected damage.
